titleZh: 暫時 ↔ 持久｜沙漏對岩石
hook: 沙漏對岩石——時間語氣對打。

members.speakLineEn: The rainbow was evanescent, fading before anyone finished taking a photo.
members.speakLineZh: 彩虹稍縱即逝，還沒人拍完照就消散了。

members.speakLineEn: Their transient joy at winning faded when the makeup exam schedule arrived.
members.speakLineZh: 獲勝的短暫喜悅，在補考日程公布後就淡了。

members.speakLineEn: The club offered a provisional schedule until the gym renovation dates were fixed.
members.speakLineZh: 在體育館整修日期確定前，社團先提供臨時課表。

members.speakLineEn: We made a tentative plan for Saturday, knowing rain might force a change.
members.speakLineZh: 我們訂了週六暫定計畫，知道下雨可能被迫改期。

members.speakLineEn: A fleeting smile crossed her face when the surprise guest walked onstage.
members.speakLineZh: 驚喜嘉賓走上舞台時，她臉上閃過飛逝一笑。

members.speakLineEn: An impromptu sing-along filled the bus after the power outage canceled the show.
members.speakLineZh: 停電取消演出後，車上臨時發起即興合唱。

related.synonyms: ad-lib, extemporaneous, extemporary, extempore, offhand, offhanded

members.senseAnchor: 臨時湊合的；應急手段的
members.zhGloss: 臨時湊合的；應急手段的
members.speakLineEn: They built a makeshift desk from two crates and a borrowed plywood board.
members.speakLineZh: 他們用兩只木箱和一塊借來的夾板，搭出臨時湊合的書桌。

members.speakLineEn: A short respite under the shade gave the hikers strength for the final climb.
members.speakLineZh: 樹蔭下短暫休息，讓健行者有力氣完成最後爬升。

related.synonyms: reprieve, recess, break, suspension, hiatus, abatement
related.antonyms: conform to, keep, make, promote, repair

members.speakLineEn: A weekend reprieve from deadlines let her sleep without setting an alarm.
members.speakLineZh: 週末暫緩交件壓力，讓她能不設鬧鐘好好睡。

members.speakLineEn: The neon shoelace fad lasted one month and then vanished from campus fashion.
members.speakLineZh: 螢光鞋帶這股短暫流行只撐一個月，就從校園時尚消失。

members.speakLineEn: The exhibit explored the impermanence of sand sculptures washed away by tides.
members.speakLineZh: 展覽探討沙雕被潮水沖走的無常與暫時性。

members.speakLineEn: She kept an abiding love for piano lessons long after childhood recitals ended.
members.speakLineZh: 童年鋼琴發表會結束後很久，她仍保持持久的鋼琴課熱愛。

members.speakLineEn: Parking shortages are a perennial complaint at the start of every fall term.
members.speakLineZh: 停車位不足是每年秋季開學時的常年抱怨。

members.speakLineEn: Repeating a false story online can perpetuate harm long after the facts appear.
members.speakLineZh: 在網路重複假故事，可能在真相出現後仍使傷害長存。

members.speakLineEn: The mural promised eternal friendship among classmates who painted it together.
members.speakLineZh: 壁畫承諾一起彩繪的同學之間有永久友誼。

related.synonyms: ageless, aeonian, eonian, everlasting, perpetual, unending

members.speakLineEn: Incessant construction noise made afternoon naps almost impossible in the dorm.
members.speakLineZh: 不停的工地噪音，讓宿舍下午幾乎無法小睡。

related.synonyms: ceaseless, constant, never-ending, perpetual, unceasing, unremitting

members.speakLineEn: Good habits can outlast a single exam season and shape your whole semester.
members.speakLineZh: 好習慣能比單一考季更持久，並形塑整個學期。

members.speakLineEn: These durable backpacks survive rain, bus rides, and four years of heavy books.
members.speakLineZh: 這些耐用背包經得起雨淋、搭車，以及四年沉重課本。

members.speakLineEn: A recurrent headache every Monday made her rethink late Sunday study marathons.
members.speakLineZh: 每週一再出現的頭痛，讓她重新思考週日熬夜讀書馬拉松。

members.speakLineEn: Writers sometimes sequester themselves in a quiet cabin to finish a draft.
members.speakLineZh: 作家有時會把自己隔絕在安靜小屋，專心寫完草稿。

related.synonyms: impound, attach, confiscate, seize, seclude, sequestrate

members.speakLineEn: During intermission, the audience stretched and bought snacks in the lobby.
members.speakLineZh: 中場休息時，觀眾在大廳伸懶腰並買零食。

related.antonyms: conform to, keep, make, promote, repair

members.speakLineEn: His offhand remark about the budget sounded careless, though he meant no harm.
members.speakLineZh: 他對預算的即興隨便評論聽來輕率，雖然他無意傷害。

related.synonyms: ad-lib, extemporaneous, extemporary, extempore, impromptu, offhanded

members.speakLineEn: The rugged hillside path demanded hiking boots instead of thin campus sneakers.
members.speakLineZh: 崎嶇山坡小徑需要登山靴，而不是單薄的校園球鞋。

members.speakLineEn: Waiting for delayed grades felt like a tiny academic purgatory each December.
members.speakLineZh: 每年十二月等延遲成績，都像短暫的學術煉獄。

members.speakLineEn: The flood was a calamity that closed three schools for the entire spring.
members.speakLineZh: 那場洪水是大災難，讓三所學校整個春天都關閉。
